sentences.l2: 我有一件T恤，这是我最喜欢的衣服。
sentences.l1: I have a T-shirt, and this is the clothing I like best.

sentences.l2: 这件T恤是白色的，上面有一个很可爱的图案。
sentences.l1: This T-shirt is white, and on it there is a very cute pattern.

sentences.l2: 图案是一只小猫，它穿着一件小小的衣服，手里拿着一个鱼。
sentences.l1: The pattern is a little cat, which is wearing a tiny piece of clothing and holding a fish in its hand.

sentences.l2: 这只小猫看起来非常开心。
sentences.l1: This little cat looks very happy.

sentences.l2: 我喜欢这件T恤，因为它非常舒服。
sentences.l1: I like this T-shirt because it is very comfortable.

sentences.l2: 夏天穿的时候，感觉很凉快。
sentences.l1: When I wear it in summer, it feels very cool.

sentences.l2: 冬天我也可以在里面穿一件长袖的衣服。
sentences.l1: In winter I can also wear a long-sleeved top underneath it.

sentences.l2: 这件T恤的布料很好，洗了很多次，图案也没有掉色。
sentences.l1: The fabric of this T-shirt is very good, and even after being washed many times, the pattern has not faded either.

sentences.l2: 每次我穿这件T恤的时候，我都会觉得很开心。
sentences.l1: Every time I wear this T-shirt, I feel very happy.

sentences.l2: 它让我觉得自己很特别。
sentences.l1: It makes me feel that I am very special.

sentences.l2: 有时候，我的朋友们也会夸这件T恤的图案好看。
sentences.l1: Sometimes my friends also praise the pattern on this T-shirt as nice-looking.

sentences.l2: 我希望这件T恤可以穿很久很久。
sentences.l1: I hope this T-shirt can be worn for a very, very long time.

sentences.l2: 它不仅仅是一件衣服，更是我生活中一个快乐的小伙伴。
sentences.l1: It is not just a piece of clothing, but even more a happy little companion in my life.
